artifact_delivered: HMM regime detection benchmarked vs MA across 4 assets — HMM consistently outperforms MA in walk-forward but neither beats B&H reliably
workstream_summary: C538: Built bin/hmm_regime_trading.py — compares HMM vs MA regime detection for RA-DQN trading. HMM produces 17-21 coherent regime segments vs MA's 40-77 switches. HMM-DQN beats MA-DQN across all 4 assets (TSLA 1/3, NVDA +10pp avg, SPY 2/3, AAPL 3/3) but neither consistently beats B&H. DQN overfits in-sample (+41% to +156%) while generalizing at +4% to +18%. Key insight: regime signal quality matters less than DQN sample efficiency.
